# Required verification and delivery gates

Read this reference for every write task. Verification is static by default;
never omit binary scope, parse, Canvas decode, XML semantics, or idempotence for
modified client resources.

## Before committing generated bytes

- Capture SHA-256, raw record bytes/spans, and sibling order for the baseline.
- Generate into memory or a task-specific staging artifact first.
- Reject removals, additions, replacements, or reorderings outside the
  explicitly approved property roots.
- Parse with the target GMS key; require `truncated == False` and an empty
  `parse_warnings` list.
- Decode all affected Canvas payloads and validate expected visible pixels.
- Parse all changed XML and compare semantic changes to approved IDs/paths.
- Commit atomically only after these checks pass.

## Idempotence

Record hashes of every target, run the generator again, and require no changes
and identical hashes. If a second run reorders, rewrites, removes/readds, or
changes an anchor, the generator is unsafe even if both outputs parse.

## Static and contract checks

Run the checks relevant to the touched files:

```bash
rtk python3 -m py_compile <modified-python-files>
rtk node --check <modified-js-file>
rtk python3 <targeted-contract-test.py>
rtk python3 -m unittest quest_manager.test_app
rtk git diff --check
```

Run broader contracts when feasible. Report unrelated pre-existing failures;
do not restore unrelated work or weaken assertions to obtain a green result.

Do not run WZ packing, Maven packaging, or DLL builds as part of the default
workflow. Run them only when the user explicitly requests that artifact in the
current task. Static verification must operate on the canonical IMG/XML/source
files and must not depend on a generated package.

## Final review

Before reporting completion:

1. Re-read `rtk git status --short` and distinguish task changes from user
   changes.
2. Inspect the final diff/stat and exact approved file set.
3. Report raw-record change counts, additions, parse results, Canvas results,
   generator idempotence, and relevant static/contract-test results.
4. List remaining real-client checks: launch, login, task visibility and
   completion, map transition/spawn, animations, drops, repeated use, and any
   other behavior the offline tools cannot prove.

## Delivery

Validate locally first. Copy only explicitly requested runtime files, preserve
names and relative layout, compare source/destination SHA-256 for every copy,
and report the exact directory. Do not copy temporary baselines, backups,
verification WZ files, probe builds, or unrelated dirty-worktree files.
